message: Can't open drducbook-asset://catalog/local-ai-hy-mt2 caused by ActivityNotFoundException
root_cause: AiRouterScreen used Compose LocalUriHandler.openUri() which delegates to external Intent.ACTION_VIEW instead of in-app ContextExtensions.openUrl() that resolves internal drducbook-asset:// URIs
fix_applied: Replaced LocalUriHandler with LocalContext and used context.openUrl() in AiRouterScreen.kt

message: Error 1033 and unexpected tunnel stop on network flapping without auto-reconnect
root_cause: CloudflareTunnelManager had no retry loop on process exit and MyViewModel was actively stopping the tunnel on temporary network disconnects without restarting
fix_applied: Added RECONNECTING phase, exponential backoff auto-restart (5 retries: 2s to 32s), removed kill-on-network-drop in MyViewModel, and added retryIfFailed on network recovery

message: Audible pause and stutter between chunk transitions in WebService reader
root_cause: Sequential audio element creation after onended, cache-busting timestamp bypassing browser cache, and roundtrip network download for silent/whitespace chunks
fix_applied: Implemented audio double buffering, preloaded Audio instances in background, removed cache-busting query param, and skipped network roundtrip for silent chunks using backend silent flag

message: Downloaded GGUF models fail to load: native bridge unavailable, backend DL missing, GGUF integrity unchecked, memory pressure unguarded, and Local AI architecture coupled to AI Cloud Router prevents independent use
root_cause: 5 root causes: (1) liblegado_local_ai.so missing on non-arm64 devices, (2) GGML_BACKEND_DL .so files not packaged in APK splits, (3) Only magic-byte validation, no size/integrity check, (4) No memory pre-check before KV cache allocation, (5) LOCAL_GGUF is a sub-protocol of PROVIDER_APP_AI cloud router causing unnecessary routing overhead and prompt mismatch
fix_applied: PENDING: 4-phase fix: Phase 1 fix loading diagnostics, Phase 2 create independent PROVIDER_LOCAL_AI with LocalAiTranslationGateway, Phase 3 decouple UI, Phase 4 optimize performance

message: Asset Delivery model download reported imported package but localAiModelPath was not updated and UI remained empty, causing test translation failure
root_cause: AssetDeliveryImportRepository called importModel but never set TranslationConfig.localAiModelPath. Additionally, TranslationConfigScreen localAiModelPath was not reactive in Compose state and lacked auto-discovery fallback across asset_delivery and local-ai storage directories
fix_applied: 1) Set TranslationConfig.localAiModelPath in AssetDeliveryImportRepository upon LOCAL_AI artifact import; 2) Added multi-directory fallback scan in LocalAiTranslationRepository.resolveModelPath; 3) Made localAiModelPath a reactive Compose MutableState and added auto-discovery LaunchedEffect in TranslationConfigScreen.

context: LocalAI Native Bridge R8 Proguard Obfuscation
message: App crash with SIGABRT / AssertNoPendingExceptionForNewException in Java_io_legado_app_data_repository_LocalAiNativeBridge_generate during test translation in release build
root_cause: R8 minification obfuscated LocalAiNativeBridge.Callback methods (onToken, isCancelled), causing JNI GetMethodID to fail with NoSuchMethodError in release build. In addition, throw_java did not call ExceptionClear prior to throwing new Java exceptions
fix_applied: 1) Added -keep rules in proguard-rules.pro for LocalAiNativeBridge, inner Callback interface, and domain/repository classes; 2) Added ExceptionClear before GetMethodID lookups and ThrowNew in local_ai.cpp

context: LocalAI MT Prompt Language Mapping & Jinja Chat Roles
message: Test translation returned raw Chinese source text instead of translated Vietnamese
root_cause: LocalAiTranslationPrompt sent raw ISO code 'vi' in an English prompt instruction without mapping to natural language names or Chinese MT directives (e.g. 'Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt) / 请将以下文本翻译为越南语'). Additionally, system and user messages were lumped into a single USER message rather than distinct SYSTEM and USER messages required for ChatML/Jinja templates
fix_applied: 1) Added resolveTargetLanguageName mapping in LocalAiTranslationPrompt; 2) Separated buildSystemPrompt and buildUserPrompt with clear Vietnamese/Sino-Vietnamese directives; 3) Structured AiGenerateRequest with distinct SYSTEM and USER AiMessages in LocalAiTranslationRepository

message: Stream interrupted: Cấu hình AI chưa hợp lệ on Antigravity models
root_cause: Direct no-route fallback in AiRouterRepository bypasses credential injection; Antigravity provider saves empty apiKey because OAuth token is in credentials; require check failed on empty apiKey or baseUrl
fix_applied: Implemented resolveDirectRequest() to inject OAuth credentials for direct fallback; defaulted effectiveBaseUrl to ANTIGRAVITY_IDE_BASE_URL

message: WebView black screen and cramped height during ChatGPT / Gemini web login
root_cause: WebView inside ModalBottomSheet rendered black due to unset background color, lack of explicit hardware layer, unhandled redirects, and fixed 420dp height
fix_applied: Set explicit white background, hardware layer type, dynamic screen height 68% (480-700dp), shouldOverrideUrlLoading handling, and reload button

message: Google Antigravity HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on high-reasoning models in aicode-consumers
root_cause: cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com throttles high reasoning models (gemini-3.7-flash-high, claude-opus-4-6-thinking) with HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED under shared aicode-consumers pool due to MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED or RPM limit
fix_applied: Recommend using lower tier flash models (gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash-low) or spacing requests to avoid RPM throttling

message: Antigravity all models 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED due to custom systemInstruction
root_cause: cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com endpoint strictly requires ANTIGRAVITY_DEFAULT_SYSTEM in systemInstruction. When client system prompt is sent in systemInstruction, server returns HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for all models (issue #9030)
fix_applied: Keep only ANTIGRAVITY_DEFAULT_SYSTEM in systemInstruction; relocate client system prompt to contents[0]; cap Claude output at 16384; add Log.e and AppLog error reporting

message: Google Antigravity HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on all models due to missing enabledCreditTypes and single-host lock
root_cause: Consumer accounts (aicode-consumers) have 0 quota in free pool. Google Cloud Code requires 'enabledCreditTypes': ['GOOGLE_ONE_AI'] in top-level request envelope to consume Google One AI subscription credits. Furthermore, hardcoding cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com bypassed daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com managed runtime without fallback
fix_applied: 1) Injected 'enabledCreditTypes': ['GOOGLE_ONE_AI'] into Antigravity request envelope with runtimeMetadata override; 2) Removed forced cloudcode-pa string replacement in AiRouterRepository and AntigravityHandler; 3) Implemented dual-endpoint fallback between daily-cloudcode-pa and cloudcode-pa

context: AI Router / Web Providers (ChatGPT Web & Gemini Web)
message: Google accounts sign-in block in embedded WebView and duplicate stream tokens in Gemini Web
root_cause: 1) Google's AccountsSignInUi detects injected JavascriptInterface, Chromium WebView Client Hints, and suppresses WebViews with 'Trình duyệt hoặc ứng dụng này có thể không an toàn'; 2) Gemini StreamGenerate sends cumulative text chunks causing duplications if emitted naively; 3) Gemini buildLabel changes dynamically on Google servers; 4) ChatGptWebHandler ignored cookies when explicit credentials were provided manually
fix_applied: 1) Removed addJavascriptInterface for Gemini, applied Desktop Firefox UA, suppressed X-Requested-With, and added one-tap Clipboard paste and external browser launch in Tab 2; 2) Added streaming text delta accumulator; 3) Dynamically extracted snlm0e and buildLabel from live HTML; 4) Extracted cookies from explicit credentials in ChatGptWebHandler

message: Gemini Web Google sign-in blocked on WebView and UI button layout overflow
root_cause: 1) Google AccountsSignInUi strictly blocks embedded Android WebViews; guest SNlM0e was falsely treated as authenticated session without __Secure-1PSID; 2) SpaceBetween Row without weight crushed action buttons off-screen and lack of verticalScroll clipped WebView
fix_applied: 1) Defaulted selectedTab to 1 for Gemini with clear step-by-step external browser flow; required __Secure-1PSID for valid Gemini session; 2) Added verticalScroll, wrapped status & buttons in dedicated full-width Surface cards with weight(1f)/weight(2f), and sized WebView to 360dp

message: ChatGPT Web 403 and WebView insecure browser blocks resolved
root_cause: False-positive guest cookie capture, missing Sentinel token handshake, and Google WebView OAuth policy block
fix_applied: Strict JWT verification, Sentinel handshake, sticky TabRow, and external browser session token flow

message: Gemini Web silent auth failure on Google redirect, uppercase WIZ_global_data keys mismatch, and unparsed reasoning/thought streams
root_cause: 1) gemini.google.com enforces __Secure-1PSIDTS alongside __Secure-1PSID; missing TS cookie redirects to accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin which returned 200 OK HTML causing cryptic SNlM0e regex failures; 2) Chrome Console snippet outputs uppercase SNlM0e and cfb2h which were ignored by lowercase-only JSON parser; 3) Gemini stream contained thinking tags (<thought>) and multi-part candidate arrays that were not separated into reasoning vs content events; 4) Google RPC errors ([['er', ...]]) were silently dropped
fix_applied: 1) Added redirect/ServiceLogin check in GeminiWebSessionManager diagnosing missing __Secure-1PSIDTS; 2) Added case-insensitive/alias JSON parser extractJsonField supporting SNlM0e/cfb2h/cookie; 3) Implemented GeminiStreamAccumulator separating <thought> blocks into AiStreamEvent.Reasoning and remaining text into AiStreamEvent.Content; 4) Added checkRpcError detecting Google RPC errors and safety violations; 5) Added 1-click DevTools snippet copy button and real-time cookie badge in WebLoginSheet

message: Syntax error in regexp pattern near index 3 (?U)(?<=\p{L})\?(?=\p{L})
stack_trace_snippet: PatternSyntaxException: Syntax error in regexp pattern near index 3 (?U)(?<=\p{L})\?(?=\p{L})
root_cause: Android ART / ICU regex compiler does not support JDK (?U) embedded UNICODE_CHARACTER_CLASS flag, causing PatternSyntaxException at runtime
fix_applied: Removed (?U) flag; replaced with portable Unicode character classes (?<=\p{L})\?(?=\p{L}) and (?<!\p{L})(\p{Lu}\p{Ll}{1,20})\s*\?\s+(\p{Lu}\p{Ll}{1,20})(?!\p{L})

message: Translation parse error: segment 24 still contains CJK text; segment 25 still contains CJK text
root_cause: TranslationStoryMemoryUseCase created relationship placeholder entities with target = raw (untranslated CJK string). AiTranslationStoryMemory exported them into entityDictionary, and lockedDictionaryFor locked Chinese targets into locked_dictionary. System prompt Rule 3 forced AI to output Chinese target, violating Rule 5 in a perpetual retry loop.
fix_applied: 1) Set placeholder entity target = empty string; 2) Filter out CJK/raw targets in AiTranslationStoryMemory.selectContext; 3) Hard guard in lockedDictionaryFor rejecting CJK targets for Vietnamese; 4) Sanitize existing poisoned entities on loadSnapshot; 5) Enhance retry instruction with specific CJK failure details.

message: Foreign name transliterations with titles (e.g. 梅杰夫大师, 梅林侯爵) leak into translation as Han-Viet (đại sư Mai Kiệt Phu) instead of Latin (đại sư Medvedev, hầu tước Merlin)
root_cause: 1) SinoForeignNameDetector lacked compound title suffix/prefix decomposition (梅杰夫大师 was not recognized as base Medvedev + title đại sư); 2) Legacy translation_dictionary.json and ai_memory DB held Han-Viet targets (Mai Kiệt Phu) without proactive self-healing; 3) lockedDictionaryFor injected poisoned Han-Viet pairs into locked_dictionary, forcing the LLM to output Han-Viet; 4) VietnameseTranslationPostProcessor lacked fallback cleanup for rogue foreign Han-Viet names.
fix_applied: 1) Added WESTERN_TITLE_SUFFIX_MAP and WESTERN_TITLE_PREFIX_MAP in SinoForeignNameDetector.kt with title_compound decomposition; 2) Added stripVietnameseDiacritics and auto-healing in TranslationStoryMemoryUseCase.kt (healPoisonedEntities on loadSnapshot); 3) Added auto-sanitization in AiTranslationRefinePipeline.lockedDictionaryFor; 4) Added dictionary healing in DictionaryRepositoryImpl.getBookDictionaries; 5) Added post-processing safety net in VietnameseTranslationPostProcessor.fixRogueForeignHanVietNames.
